## How items appear

## 2026-09

- **2026-09-04** — 电商派. Meituan said its Shenzhen drone delivery network in Longhua upgraded hub-and-spoke points into mesh nodes (to 15 points), extending typical merchant delivery reach from about 3 km to 5 km, with Nanshan network expansion also underway. [Link](https://pai-nextjs.s5.pai.com.cn/news/01m1nj0dkp2z3bn29c14skp0xt). Official document to read instead: none (no Tracker counterpart).

- **2026-09-02** — 南方日报 (via 福建省商务厅 reprint). Shenzhen issued 《深圳市2026年优化口岸营商环境若干措施》 (“19条”), including stronger SZ–HK cross-border low-altitude logistics coordination, exploration of drone customs clearance models, orderly SZ–HK drone transport trial flights, and study of eVTOL clearance supervision. [Link](https://swt.fujian.gov.cn/xxgk/jgzn/jgcs/dtgxdc/wszx/202609/t20260902_7208045.htm). Official document to read instead: 粤府办〔2024〕6号 (SZ–HK corridor remains planned-trial under Sandbox X; not evidenced as operational on Tracker).

- **2026-09-02** — 见道网 (coverage; flight day 2026-08-28). Follow-up coverage of Hong Kong’s first public unmanned passenger eVTOL (EH216-S) trial at Cyberport under Regulatory Sandbox X unconventional-aircraft pilots, noting the government’s stated intent to study dedicated unconventional-aircraft legislation for LegCo around 2027. [Link](https://www.seetao.com/details/276927.html). Official document to read instead: Regulatory Sandbox X; Working Group on Developing Low-altitude Economy; Cap. 448G / CAD (unconventional >150 kg pathway remains Action Plan / legislation watch).
